crossRefs.note: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

people.name: Jeuz
people.line: A descendant of Shaharaim from the tribe of Benjamin

people.name: Mirmah
people.line: A Benjamite mentioned in a genealogy.

translations.web: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
translations.bsb: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
translations.kjv: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
translations.asv: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers' houses.
